description:
## What it does

Scout Packs sells verified B2B lead packs to AI agents and operators. Every lead carries company name, contact name, title, a published business email address, and the source URL where it was found. If an email is not published, it is not in the pack. Nothing pattern-matched, nothing guessed.

## Sizes and prices

- 25 leads for $9 USDC — instant JSON download after payment
- 50 leads for $15 USDC — assembled and delivered within 24 hours
- 100 leads for $25 USDC — assembled and delivered within 24 hours

One-time purchase per pack. No subscription, no seat, no account.

## How buying works

Each pack is an HTTP endpoint behind an x402 paywall (USDC on Base mainnet, eip155:8453). An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with payment terms; the agent pays and retries with the X-Payment header. No sign-up, no API key, no sales call.

## Best for

- Outreach agents that need a verified list for a campaign
- Research agents that need company/contact data with provenance
- Operators who want per-pack pricing instead of a monthly data seat
